description: Open-source AI agents that run on Maritime computers. Each entry is a folder in this repository with a one-command deploy.

agents.name: browser-use
agents.what: Give it a task in plain English and it drives a real browser to finish it.

agents.name: browser-use Web UI
agents.what: A web app for browser-use: type a task, watch the agent's browser work.

agents.name: OpenManus
agents.what: A general agent that plans, browses and uses tools to finish a task.

agents.name: Open Interpreter
agents.what: Ask in plain English; it writes and runs code on the computer until the task is done.

agents.name: Aider
agents.what: AI pair programming in a git repo: edits files, runs tests, commits.

agents.name: smolagents
agents.what: Hugging Face's agents that think in code, with web search and tools.

agents.name: crewAI
agents.what: A crew of role-playing agents that research and write together.

agents.name: goose
agents.what: A terminal agent that writes and runs shell commands and code for you.

agents.name: GPT Researcher
agents.what: Researches a question across many sources and writes a cited report.

agents.name: Mobilerun
agents.what: Uses Android apps for you: reads the screen, taps, swipes and types. Formerly DroidRun.

agents.name: mobile-use
agents.what: An agent that operates Android apps from a goal in plain English.

agents.name: Open Instinct
agents.what: A personal agent you text, with its own computer, that works with the agents of people you trust.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.what: An autonomous personal agent with a large library of skills.

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.what: Nous Research's agent that remembers you and improves its own skills.

agents.name: Codex
agents.what: OpenAI's coding agent: writes, runs and fixes code in its own workspace.

agents.name: DeepSeek Harness
agents.what: DeepSeek's plugin-based agent harness with a full web workbench.

agents.name: ZeroClaw
agents.what: A lightweight agent written in Rust, small enough to run almost anywhere.
